g.text: Coauthor assessed answer quality and retrieval baseline
Same 40 questions per answer condition | Model only: no passages or web search
Pair success: hybrid 19/20; BM25 18/20; model only 4/20. Hybrid minus BM25: +5 points (95% bootstrap -10 to +20).
All eight absent-detail answers appropriately abstained per condition. Topic and support panels partition the same questions.
Author ratings; prior project exposure and limited condition masking. Sequential BM25 extension. No established hybrid superiority.
Citation judgments differ from the preserved AI layer. Structural retrieval coverage does not establish answer correctness.
